name: Textile & Apparel
description: Printing on garments and fabric — T-shirts, hoodies, bags, décor textile (DTG / DTF).

name: Rigid Objects
description: Direct printing on rigid materials — wood, glass, metal, tile, PVC (UV Flatbed).

name: Large Format
description: Wide-format posters, banners, and signage for indoor and outdoor campaigns.

name: Custom Small Objects
description: Personalized objects with adhesive transfer film — bottles, mugs, cases (UV DTF).

name: Vinyl Cutting & Stickers
description: Contour cutting for vinyl, stickers, and heat-transfer media (cutting plotters).

name: Labels & Crystal
description: Transparent gloss labels and crystal stickers for premium packaging (UV DTF label).

name: Heat Press
description: Heat + pressure to fix DTF, DTG, and sublimation transfers onto garments.

name: Material Cutting
description: Cutting rigid and soft materials — cardboard, foam, PVC, leather, acrylic (CNC / laser).

name: Lamination & Finishing
description: Protective film lamination and finishing for prints, posters, and documents.
